text:
marta: Heads-up — thick coastal fog + gusty crosswinds on 101 this morning. Saw Muni rerouting the 5X and my scooter battery died at 26th and Broadway after a surprise puddle. Anyone else dealing with transit chaos or taking the ferry?
josh: Took the 8:50 ferry, arrived ~12m late. PA announcement said 'precautionary slow-steam' :grimacing:
commute-bot: BART status: No delays. Caltrain: minor speed restrictions due to debris near San Mateo (automated update).
sam: LOL at 'slow-steam' :joy: Also PSA — office umbrella stash is in the 3rd-floor kitchenette (blue IKEA umbrella) if anyone needs it.
linda: @marta ugh that sucks. where did you leave the scooter? i can swing by and grab it if you want.
marta: Left it by the Broadway bike rack, it's soaked and the battery is fizzing. Any quick tips to dry it faster? Also the temporary bus stop got moved two blocks north, watch out.
josh: If you can pull the battery, do that. Put it in a dry bag, maybe rice + airflow or hairdryer on low. There's a scooter repair shop (ScootFix on 18th) that usually helps.
priya: Quick poll: who’s doing ferry / shuttle bus / bike / WFH today? react with :ferry:, :bus:, :bike:, :house_with_garden:
sam: :house_with_garden: — staying home, coffee & code.
linda: :ferry: (coming in slow but steady)
marta: :bus: grabbing the replacement shuttle, ty for the umbrella tip
marta: Also — if you're planning to come in late, pls ping #eng-oncall. Do we still have the 11am sync or should we postpone?
